name: Jari Heikkinen
bio:
Jari's journey into motorsport began, unusually, with a fascination for rally cars and their liveries. He studied graphic design, then quickly transitioned to motorsport marketing after graduation. His sharp eye for detail and understanding of the Finnish motorsport heritage landed him a junior role at a local rally team, building their brand from the ground up.

He spent years honing his skills, eventually working for international teams before settling into the Caterham Academy. Jari is known for his structured and detail-oriented approach. He believes in a data-driven strategy to increase brand awareness and is passionate about finding creative ways to engage with fans. He's always pushing the boundaries of what's possible within budget, making him a valuable asset to the team.

 He is a skilled negotiator with vendors and sponsors and a staunch advocate for the Caterham brand. Jari's demanding nature stems from his high standards; he expects excellence from himself and his team, ensuring every campaign is executed flawlessly.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Jari is of average height with a slightly stocky build and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with marketing ideas, often scribbled in during meetings.
Has a particular fondness for licorice and always keeps a stash in his desk drawer.
Insists on having the office thermostat set to a very specific temperature - 21.5 degrees Celsius.
